text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 76 units of linezolid 600 mg tablets at a burn rate of 14.4 per day, providing 5.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 387.76 units at 16.1 per day, providing 24.1 days on hand. A transfer of 127 units from Corvale General would give Corvale East approximately 14 days on hand while leaving Corvale General with about two weeks of supply.

Why (FDA record): The drug label for NDC 67877041920 identifies Alkem Laboratories Limited (FEI 3006370524) as the manufacturing plant supplying both Corvale sites. FDA inspection records for this facility show a series of Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications, with the most recent inspection ending 2018-03-27 and known to FDA by 2018-06-25. No FDA inspection records after 2018-03-27 are provided in the evidence. The label registration lists the last inspection as NAI on 2019-08-30 without a corresponding FDA inspection record in the supplied data. Linezolid is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: The evidence linking current supply risk to FDA inspection history is weak. No recent FDA inspection or documented shortage cause exists. We must verify the current FDA inspection status for FEI 3006370524 and confirm allocation availability with both sites before executing any transfer.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify current FDA inspection status for FEI 3006370524 — needs: pharmacy director.
2. Confirm allocation availability with Corvale East and Corvale General — needs: pharmacy director.
3. Execute transfer of 127 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs: pharmacy director (transfer request).
4. If transfer is not feasible, evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — needs: buyer.
5. If needed, evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs: buyer.
6. If needed, evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — needs: buyer.
7. If needed, evaluate purchase from American Health Packaging — needs: buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
